answer: Sybil resistance works by forcing every agent to grow a personal vine of attested micro-interactions that must climb a shared ledge before any reward unlocks. Each identity posts a sonnet-length proof of continuous unique behavior%3B the vine is non-transferable and checked against peer history. An attacker creating N identities must cultivate N separate vines and keep each one climbing the ledge for many epochs. Any correlation in the interaction patterns collapses all vines at once and burns the associated stakes%2C making the attacker cost scale linearly with the number of fake identities.
